scope.hostStructuralFixtureBoundary: Explicit unbranded non-IR host records with owning-compiler tagged children; their exercised paths project fields or reset the marker, and do not inspect brands. They are not compiler-created branded records and never enter original-IR carrier checking.

nativeChecker.recipe: Ordered raw closure with imports stripped, aggregate native preparation, original IR check, same-IR emission.
nativeChecker.parity: Checked native emission equals the native-generated N1 compiler TypeScript byte for byte.

checks: one, two, and three declaration generics in exact declaration order
interleaved type, erased proposition/proof, and runtime binders
recursive calls retain the complete runtime argument count
monomorphic recursive calls retain zero type arguments
originalIr.emittedIr: The exact original IR inspected above is passed to psTsEmitModule.

boundedScope: Finite worker and syntax/runtime evidence; authoritative sources remain Lean. No exhaustive semantic/metatheory proof, F seed promotion, or root TypeScript workspace result is asserted.
